decision_observable.consumer: layered incision operator and acquisition planner
decision_observable.time_regime: quasistatic prescribed cut trajectory; no thermal/cellular/vascular dynamics added

leaves.name: micro cleavage Gamma0
leaves.stop: 150J/m2 is synthetic short-fibril pullout ceiling, nominal fibril work12; neither chemical bond density nor cut topology maps these to skin cleavage
leaves.required: independent separation and pre-cleavage process-work assays on same skin

leaves.name: fiber bridge before blade arrival
leaves.state: monotonically recruited slip delta, anchorage l, rf, phi, shear tau
leaves.constraints: 2tau l/rf <= sigma_f; no rebinding, arbitrary recruitment or heat transfer
leaves.stop: Given independent aligned fibers. Network recruitment, orientation, force-dependent slip and actual blade arrival opening remain unknown

leaves.name: radius to blade-arrival opening
leaves.stop: Blade wedge/friction/contact stiffness/engagement require measurement or explicit resolved contact. Fiber diameter alone does not derive this map

leaves.name: skin tear observations
leaves.stop: Mode/species/cohort-specific aggregate fracture work; SD is dispersion, not joint CI; observed bridging+delamination+fiber rupture

leaves.name: layer hyperelastic bulk
leaves.state: epidermis/dermis/subcutis 2D displacement fields and F=I+grad u
leaves.energy_density: mu/2(tr F^T F-2-2ln detF)+lambda/2(ln detF)^2 + sum_s kfiber/4<(F a_s)^2-1>_+^2
leaves.stop: Finite-strain compressible membrane instrument, not measured layered skin or full 3D incompressible body; all stiffnesses and thicknesses scenario defaults

leaves.name: layer slip transfer
leaves.energy: full mirrored interface U_slip=sum_integral k|u_j-u_j+1|^2 dA
leaves.stop: Synthetic interlayer stiffness20MPa/m, test0; no measured adhesion/delamination law

leaves.name: prestretch reference
leaves.stop: single-animal control-patch marginal; used as loading scenario only, no same-specimen gap validation

leaves.name: cut energy balance
leaves.equation: F da=dU_all + sum_j h_j Gamma_j da_j + W_process + W_contact for fixed outer displacement
leaves.stop: Prescribed cut; boundary force-control needs potential energy and boundary work. No fracture nucleation/branch certificate. Energy terms for unmeasured layers remain null

leaves.name: intrinsic/process identifiability
leaves.equation: radius-series Jacobian has identical columns for Gamma0 and constant process B0; kernel(1,-1,0,0)
leaves.stop: Exact under declared additive observation model. Microscopic process-work acquisition breaks the null direction; precision and validity in skin remain unknown

leaves.name: vascular/cellular ports
leaves.stop: no same-specimen vessel geometry, cell strain transfer or viability kinetics; do not reinterpret exudate as blood

inventory.created: new projected crack area; surface work accumulated once along monotone trajectory
inventory.dissipated: pre-cleavage bridge work and contact explicitly separate
inventory.global_balance: coupling slip forces equal and opposite; no resetting tear history to produce cheap queries

stopping_argument: Finer mesh cannot identify Gamma0/B0 or layer closures. Stop numerical work after specified gap refinement/interventions; acquire same-sample microscopic work/contact/release rather than further certifier development.
discriminating_test: unfitted 15000J/m2 against both skin tear modes; radius/intercept vs independent pre-cleavage work; partial-depth layered gap versus decoupled model; conventional inverse receives same data
